method: Specialized regex/literal scan for explicit Windows drive paths, the known local username path, and HF credential assignment patterns.
published_boundaries: Private roots/checkouts/model/Python paths use explicit placeholders. Original path-bearing logs and raw samples stay external. Inputs/history/translations are the fixed synthetic fixture. Lifecycle conflict observations capture names/PIDs only, not unrelated command lines.
environment_policy: Owned model child environments omit HF_TOKEN, HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN and LLAMA_* variables; the existing source-known GGML control allowlist is removed. This is not an all-environment-secret removal claim.
limits: Bounded path/credential-pattern scan, not comprehensive secret detection. Native addresses/PIDs/adapter IDs required for experimental evidence remain; no personal local paths are published.
